title: Expand EU-PII-001 allowed regions
author: security-team
description: Demonstrates a policy version change. The policy EU-PII-001 is updated from version 1 to version 2, expanding allowedRegions from [EU] to [EU, US].
expectedBehavior: Policy changes require security team review. The CI checker should flag this as a policy modification and require approval before merging. Whether the change is valid or invalid depends on the organization's risk tolerance.
note: This example documents a policy change scenario. The CI checker should detect the policy file change and flag it for review.
